notes.title: Free 18+ patch added as DLC!
notes.notes:
Thanks to Valve's new policy in allowing adult only titles, Wolf Tail's adult patch has been added as a free DLC:

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32569940/bdcb48c5ce9f003ee4c5aa832055b35738784fc8.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/943850/Wolf_Tails_Adult_Patch/
 
After the uncertain future for games with risque content faced previously, I'm legitimately thrilled that Valve is approving adult content on it's storefront. If you have the game installed, and your settings allow adult only titles, the patch should be installed automatically.

-Razz

notes.title: Special update coming soon!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32569940/8805e3fc5a2d5a582b9c7ddca975543e884bd502.jpg

First off I want to give a huge thank you to everyone who bought the game and also those of you who reviewed. This really helps me out immeasurably as a dev here on Steam, and I’m always thankful for your support.

I am preparing a special update for the much requested ability to romance Mirari and Fuyu at the same time. There's going to be new CGs and a new ending once you follow a certain path in the game. The update will be 100% free and should hopefully roll out in the coming months. 

I'll also be sure to post another announcement here when it goes live!
-Razz
